title: Cache Cluster Process Crash with Cascading Database Load
description: Cache cluster nodes crashed due to out-of-memory errors, driving cache availability to 0% and causing 100% cache-miss traffic to cascade directly into the primary database.

initial_fault_report.headline: Cache Cluster Unreachable & Database Latency Degradation (2100ms)
initial_fault_report.details: Cache connection refused across all application nodes; DB connection pool surging.

telemetry.details: Application cache client reports 100% connection failures and 0% availability across all cache pools.
Database connection pool saturated at 88% capacity from unbuffered direct queries.

health_probe.details: Direct TCP ping to cache cluster failed with connection refused on port 6379.
Direct synthetic query probe on database responds in 1.9ms; DB storage and engine are healthy.

operational_events.details: Kernel OOM killer terminated Redis cluster daemon process (code 137) due to memory threshold breach.
